blocks.text:
`Widget`s can be identified as sources or targets using
`Gtk::DragSource` and `Gtk::DropTarget`
event controllers.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Widget的以下方法可以将Widget作为源或者目标：

blocks.text:
`void set_content(const Glib::RefPtr<Gdk::ContentProvider>& content)`:
        Sets a content provider on the drag source.
blocks.zh: `void set_content(const Glib::RefPtr<Gdk::ContentProvider>& content)`：在拖拽源上设置内容提供者。

blocks.text:
`void set_actions(Gdk::DragAction actions)`:
        Sets the actions on the drag source. For instance `Gdk::DragAction::COPY
        | Gdk::DragAction::MOVE`.
blocks.zh: `void set_actions(Gdk::DragAction actions)`：设置拖拽源支持的动作，例如 `Gdk::DragAction::COPY | Gdk::DragAction::MOVE`。

blocks.text:
`void set_icon(const Glib::RefPtr<const Gdk::Paintable>& paintable, int hot_x, int hot_y)`:
        Sets a paintable to use as icon during DND operations.
blocks.zh: `void set_icon(const Glib::RefPtr<const Gdk::Paintable>& paintable, int hot_x, int hot_y)`：设置在拖放操作期间用作图标的 paintable。

blocks.text:
`void set_gtypes(const std::vector<GType>& types)`:
        Sets the supported types for this drop target.
blocks.zh: `void set_gtypes(const std::vector<GType>& types)`：设置这个放置目标支持的类型。

blocks.text:
`void set_actions(Gdk::DragAction actions)`:
        Sets the actions that this drop target supports.
blocks.zh: `void set_actions(Gdk::DragAction actions)`：设置这个放置目标支持的动作。

blocks.text:
`Glib::ValueBase get_value() const`:
        Gets the current drop data, as a `Glib::Value`.

`void reject()`:
        Rejects the ongoing drop operation. This function should be used when
        delaying the decision on whether to accept a drag or not until after
        reading the data.
blocks.zh: `void reject()`：拒绝正在进行的放置操作。如果要等读取完数据之后才决定是否接受拖拽，就应使用这个函数。
